findings.explanation: Steps 1-5 are duplicated with generic modular input/HEC boilerplate appended to the end of the field.
findings.quote:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Cisco DC Networking App / NX-OS Add-on — Splunk Add-on for Cisco Security (Splunkbase 1352)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=cisco:nxos:syslog, cisco:iosxe into network. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicated trailing boilerplate lifecycle steps and retain the NX-OS EVPN implementation guide.
